name: Level Drop
description: Auto-import .gmd and level-string files from a drop folder

drop-folder.name: Drop folder
drop-folder.description: Folder watched for .gmd / .txt level files. Imported files move to imported/, failures to failed/ (with a .log).

auto-save.name: Auto-save after import
auto-save.description: Save the game (CCLocalLevels.dat) right after levels are imported, so they survive a crash.

replace-same-name.name: Replace same-name levels
replace-same-name.description: When an imported level has the same name as existing local levels, delete the old ones (My Levels) and keep the new import.
